items.risk: ppt-web features/compliance ships 3 pages and 7 components behind a single test file (AmlDashboardPage.test.tsx). It is simultaneously the window's highest-churn UI area (AmlDashboardPage.tsx and ReviewAssessmentDialog.tsx both in CHURN_FILES) and the most regulated one (AML / EDD / DSA decisions).
items.mitigation: Set a test floor for features/compliance: a test file per dialog and page before further regulated-flow changes land (ReviewAssessmentDialog, InitiateEddDialog, ContentModerationPage first).

items.risk: 8 of the 13 PRs merged this window (AML/compliance, facilities booking, verification badge, voice assistant) map to NO story in coverage.json. QA therefore has no acceptance-criteria anchor for the majority of the code actually changing, and the gap-driven ranker cannot see that work at all.
items.mitigation: Run the local deep /ppt-project-management scan to re-derive the story set from the current epics catalog; until then treat post-merge review findings as the only AC signal for those areas.

items.risk: Post-merge review has become the de-facto correctness gate rather than a safety net. post-merge-review.json with_issues/prs_scanned went 0/52 across 2026-08-06..08-14 to 8/36 across 2026-08-20..08-23 (22%). Defects now reach `dev` and get fixed on `dev`, so every regression costs a full extra PR cycle and inflates apparent throughput.
items.mitigation: Track post-merge rework rate in the digest; move the two enumerable defect classes (DB-concurrency, component-lifecycle) into the pre-merge reviewer's required checks so the ratio is observable and falling.

items.risk: The pre-merge review gate is accepting LEVEL-MISMATCHED tests, not missing ones. 5 of 13 PRs merged this window were from-merged-review follow-ups and two files were each patched twice inside 48h. #2826 added migration 00234 + repository changes with 8 pure in-process #[test] and zero #[sqlx::test], and regressed as #2831 (cross-replica double delivery); #2829 added 4 happy-path `it()` cases with no dialog-remount case and regressed as #2832 (stale EDD/Review state). pr-reviewer-prompt.md explicitly tells the reviewer to 'Skim' test files, so both read as well-tested.
items.mitigation: Add a risk-class -> required-test-level table to pr-reviewer-prompt.md and a mechanical gate: diff touching backend/crates/db/migrations/** must add >=1 #[sqlx::test]; diff touching a *Dialog.tsx holding useState must add a re-open-for-different-subject case.

items.risk: PR #2838 centralized voice OAuth token encryption as a single-file change to routes/voice_webhooks.rs with one added test marker — on a file already tracked as a repeated churn hotspot. A crypto-centralization refactor without encrypt/decrypt round-trip, wrong-key and legacy-plaintext-read coverage can fail silently in prod (tokens that decrypt to garbage rather than erroring).
items.mitigation: Add the three regression cases before further voice_webhooks.rs churn; treat crypto-touching diffs as a required-test risk class in the reviewer prompt.

items.risk: Accounting MVP-loop trio (#2555 / #2558 / #2559, UC-ACC-05) is now 26 days open with still zero reviewer engagement and no commits since the last run. The whole accounting/invoice MVP loop is frozen behind it, and it has been the named top delivery blocker since 2026-07-30 without movement.
items.mitigation: Assign a named reviewer this run and merge, or close all three and re-plan the accounting slice as fresh dispatcher tasks.
